### Frequently asked questions

Does DreamLab run AI and agentic training in the Lake District?

Yes. DreamLab runs residential AI and agents training from its facility in the Lake District, Cumbria. Teams work with specialists on agentic workflows, AI integration and rapid prototyping, scoped to their own projects, and can continue with the free self-guided curriculum afterwards.

What is DreamLab?

DreamLab is an Applied Innovation Lab in the UK Lake District. Teams work alongside a network of 40+ deep-tech specialists on AI, immersive XR, cyber trust and creative technology through residential programmes and embedded R&D residencies.

Where is DreamLab located?

DreamLab operates from a residential facility in the Lake District, Cumbria, United Kingdom. Programmes are residential: participants stay on site, combining focused technical work with the setting of a UNESCO World Heritage landscape.

What do the residential programmes involve?

Residential programmes are intensive deep-tech training for enterprise and SME teams. Each programme pairs a team with relevant specialists from the DreamLab network to transfer applied skills in AI, XR, virtual production or cyber trust, scoped to the team's real projects.

Are the self-guided courses free?

Yes. DreamLab publishes a free 10-phase, 57+ hour self-guided curriculum covering AI foundations, AI APIs, Claude Code, local AI and RAG, Docker, AI agents and orchestration, QA and publishing, and SEO and AI discoverability. No registration is required.

Who are DreamLab programmes for?

DreamLab serves enterprise and SME teams that need applied capability, not just theory: engineering groups adopting AI, studios moving into virtual production, and organisations building trustworthy, secure systems. Programmes are scoped per team rather than sold as fixed courses.

How do I book a discovery call with DreamLab?

Use the contact form at dreamlab-ai.com/contact or email info@dreamlab-ai.com. The contact form is end-to-end encrypted and stores nothing in a database. A discovery call scopes your team's goals before any programme is proposed.

#### Enterprise

#### SME

Start with our self-guided workshops or enquire about a structured innovation sprint.

We're outcome driven, able to combine modules across categories to fit your needs.Every engagement is scoped and priced for your team. As a guide, residential programmes start from £995 per person per day, full-board, and one-day build sprints from £2,500.

## Co-create

Source: https://dreamlab-ai.com/co-create/

## Co-Create With Us

Bring your toughest challenge to our Lake District lab. Your team works alongside 40+ deep tech specialists in an environment designed for focused, intensive co-creation. We do not just advise. We build with you.

### Three Ways to Engage

Whether you are a multinational scoping an innovation programme or an SME with a specific technical challenge, there is a pathway that fits.

#### Enterprise Residency

1-3 days, bespoke

Your team embeds in the lab for intensive R&D sprints. We assign a dedicated multi-disciplinary team from our specialist collective, matched to your domain and challenge.

Typical outcome: Validated prototype at TRL 4-6 with deployment roadmap

#### SME Innovation Sprint

1-3 days, structured

Structured programmes for smaller companies ready to apply deep tech. You arrive with a challenge and leave with a working solution and the skills to maintain it.

Typical outcome: Deployable MVP and team upskilling

#### KTP Partnership

12-36 months, Innovate UK funded

Knowledge Transfer Partnerships place a graduate associate in your organisation, co-supervised by our research team. Innovate UK funds up to 67% of the cost for SMEs, making this the most cost-effective route to long-term capability transfer.

Typical outcome: Embedded capability, new products/processes, academic publications

### Lab Environment

Our Lake District facility is purpose-built for intensive co-creation. Teams work in a residential setting with production-grade infrastructure, surrounded by the natural environment that research consistently links to creative problem-solving and sustained focus.

Additional capabilities: LED volume stage, Dolby Atmos studio, motion capture suite, dedicated training rooms, and social spaces for informal knowledge exchange.

### How It Works

Every engagement follows a structured process from discovery through deployment, with clear milestones and deliverables at each stage.

#### Discovery

We map your challenge, assess technology readiness, and identify the right combination of expertise. No commitment required.

#### Scope

Define deliverables, team composition, timeline, and success criteria. We identify funding opportunities including Innovate UK grants and KTP schemes.

#### Build

Your team embeds in the lab alongside our specialists. Hands-on co-creation with daily standups and working prototypes from day one.

#### Validate

Test against real data, real users, and real constraints. We apply the AREA Responsible Innovation framework to anticipate downstream impacts.

#### Deploy

Handover of validated prototype, documentation, and deployment roadmap. Post-engagement support ensures continuity.

### UK Innovation Funding

We actively support grant applications and help position your engagement within the UK innovation landscape. Our programmes target the TRL 4-7 sweet spot where Innovate UK funding has the greatest impact.

##### Knowledge Transfer Partnerships

12-36 month embedded graduate associates, up to 67% funded for SMEs

##### Technology Missions Fund

Collaborative R&D aligned with UKRI priority areas including AI assurance and net zero

##### Digital Catapult Programmes

We partner with Digital Catapult as the natural Catapult for our creative and immersive tech work

We have experience with Innovate UK applications and can advise on framing your project within the Technology Missions Fund language and the AREA Responsible Innovation framework.

### Start With a Conversation

Book a 30-minute discovery call. We will map your challenge, identify the right engagement model, and explore funding options. No commitment, no pitch deck required.

## VENTURE LAB

Deep tech expertise on demand.

Access 40+ specialists, enterprise infrastructure, and 30 years of R&D heritage, without building it all yourself.

### Building deep tech is hard. It doesn't have to be slow.

Most startups either hire expensive specialists they can't fully utilise, or try to build everything with a generalist team and burn months on the wrong approach. Venture Lab gives you targeted access to the right expertise at the right moment.

#### Without us

- 6+ months hiring a specialist

- Wrong architecture decisions compound

- Investor questions you can't answer

- Grant applications miss the mark

#### With Venture Lab

- Working prototype in 1–3 days

- Architecture validated by specialists

- Technical narrative for investors

- Innovate UK applications positioned

### Four ways in. One conversation to start.

Start with a free discovery session. Progress through structured tiers as your needs grow. No lock-in at any stage.

#### Discovery Session

Understand what's possible

- Technical assessment of your product and stack

- Identify 2-3 deep tech opportunities

- Funding landscape briefing (Innovate UK, UKRI, EIS/SEIS)

- Written summary with recommended next steps

Outcome: Clarity on where deep tech accelerates your roadmap

#### Build Sprint

One day. One prototype. Real validation.

- Pre-sprint scoping call to define the build target

- Full-day co-creation with 2-3 matched specialists

- Working prototype connected to your stack

- Architecture review and scaling recommendations

- 2 weeks async follow-up support

Outcome: A validated proof-of-concept and the confidence to invest further

#### Venture Residency

Immersive co-creation at our Lake District lab

- Dedicated multi-disciplinary specialist team (3-8 people)

- Full residential accommodation with meals

- Enterprise GPU cluster, LED volume, and lab access

- Production-grade prototypes, not just demos

- Strategic roadmap and deployment architecture

- 4 weeks post-residency support

- IP ownership retained by your company

Outcome: A production-ready prototype, strategic roadmap, and a team that knows how to build on it

#### Venture Partner

Ongoing deep tech advisory and build capacity

- Fractional CTO and specialist access on demand

- Monthly architecture reviews and technical advisory

- Priority scheduling for build sprints and residencies

- Investor-ready technical due diligence support

- Introductions to our VC and accelerator network

- Grant application support (Innovate UK, UKRI)

Outcome: A deep tech bench that scales with you, without the overhead of building it in-house

### Who Venture Lab is for

Founders, CTOs, and technical leaders building products where deep tech is the differentiator.

#### Pre-Seed & Seed Startups

Validating a deep tech product thesis. You need specialist expertise to build the first version properly.

#### Series A-B Scaleups

Growing fast and hitting technical ceilings. You need architecture, AI capabilities, or infrastructure that your team hasn't built before.

#### VC Portfolio Companies

Portfolio-wide access to deep tech specialists. We partner with funds to provide structured technical support across investments.

#### Accelerator Cohorts

Cohort-based build sprints and demo day preparation. We integrate with your programme timeline.

Six deep tech domains, each backed by specialists with decades of combined experience. We match the right people to your problem.

## Free self-guided workshops

Source: https://dreamlab-ai.com/workshops/

## AI-Powered Knowledge Work

Master AI tools across 10 structured phases — from first setup to being found online

### Your Learning Journey

10 phases from foundations to discoverability. Click any phase to begin.

### Complete Curriculum

#### Foundations

Tools, Environment & First Steps

Set up your AI development environment with VS Code, Git, GitHub, and essential extensions. Three complementary workshops cover infrastructure basics, IDE configuration, and a comprehensive VS Code reference.

#### Visual Documentation & Version Control

Diagrams, Git Mastery & Professional Workflows

Master Mermaid diagrams for flowcharts, Gantt charts, and sequence diagrams. Deepen your Git skills with visual tools, branching strategies, and collaborative workflows.

#### AI APIs & Vibe Coding

Connect, Create & Converse with AI

Connect directly to AI APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Then master conversational programming — building applications through natural language dialogue with AI.

#### Claude Code Mastery

Anthropic’s Agentic Coding Tool

Master Claude Code CLI from installation through CLAUDE.md project configuration, MCP server integration, hooks, subagents, and workflow orchestration.

#### Local AI & RAG Systems

Private Models & Knowledge Pipelines

Run AI models locally with Ollama for complete data privacy. Then build retrieval-augmented generation systems that make AI an expert on your own documents.

#### Docker & Containers

Reproducible, Portable Environments

Master Docker fundamentals and containerisation. Use VS Code Dev Containers for reproducible environments and remote Docker for GPU-accelerated development.

#### AI Agents & Orchestration

Specialised Agents & Multi-Agent Systems

Create specialised AI agents using the ReAct pattern. Then coordinate multi-agent workflows with cost controls, safety measures, and approval chains.

#### AI Coding Ecosystem

Tools, Security & Professional Practice

Survey the full AI coding landscape — Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf. Understand security implications, ethical considerations, and professional practice.

#### QA, Publishing & Capstone

Ship Confidently, Deliver Professionally

Build automated testing pipelines with AI-powered quality engineering tools including Agentic QE Fleet. Then master professional publishing workflows for deployment and documentation.

#### SEO & AI Discoverability

Be Found by Search Engines and Answer Engines

Make what you publish findable and citable. Audit crawling and rendering, write valid JSON-LD, set a deliberate policy for AI crawlers, and structure content so answer engines quote it accurately.

### Ready to Transform Your Workflow?

Our residential training programme delivers this curriculum, shaped to your team, with expert guidance over 1–3 days. Or work through it at your own pace online.

## Research

Source: https://dreamlab-ai.com/research/

## 16 Years of Deep Tech Research

The Octave laboratory (2007-2023) produced world-first collaborative immersive systems worth over £8M in research value. That research heritage now forms the foundation of our Applied Innovation Lab, commercialising deep tech for real-world impact.

#### Multi-Viewpoint Immersive AI Research Platform

### Core Innovation

#### Collaborative Immersion

Multiple specialists work together in a single immersive space with individual stereoscopic viewpoints, a world first in collaborative VR.

#### AI-Assisted Telepresence

Remote collaborators are brought into the space with full body presence and spatial audio. AI observes all communication channels in real-time.

#### Wave Field Synthesis

Spatial audio and volumetric telepresence enable natural, trust-based interaction, critical for multi-disciplinary problem solving.

### Flow State Advantage

#### Focused Data Presentation

Each expert sees only their relevant data: no overload, no context switching. Domain-specific views reduce cognitive load.

#### Natural Interaction

Spatial interaction and communication are preserved. Professionals reach peak performance rapidly because the technology gets out of the way.

#### AI Learns from the Best

AI captures what each expert sees, says, and does, building a multi-viewpoint knowledge graph richer than any single perspective. It learns from the best, not the confused.

### Real-World Impact

#### Nuclear Decommissioning Case Study

Planning time reduced from 8 hours to 2 hours

With improved safety outcomes and reduced specialist fatigue

AI learned and propagated emergent protocols (including 3D gesture languages and risk communication systems) across teams and domains. This is the kind of applied innovation that our lab now commercialises for industry.

### Technical Summary

### From Research to Applied Innovation

#### 2007-2015

Foundation research: multi-viewpoint stereo, wave field synthesis, gesture tracking. Building the core immersive collaboration platform.

#### 2015-2019

AI observation and mediation. Nuclear decommissioning case study. Team ontology emergence mapping.

#### 2019-2023

Expansion to larger teams and new domains. Standards development. Commercialisation groundwork.

#### 2024+

Applied Innovation Lab. Research heritage deployed as co-creation capability for enterprises and SMEs.

### Research Demonstrations

Capability demonstrations from the Octave laboratory, spanning VR collaboration, nuclear robotics, spatial interaction, and large-scale data visualisation.

#### Immersive VR Collaboration

Multi-viewpoint virtual reality system enabling natural spatial collaboration between specialists in a shared immersive environment.

#### Nuclear Decommissioning

Real-world application that reduced planning time from 8 hours to 2 hours with improved safety outcomes for specialist teams.

#### Interactive Technologies

##### Hand Tracking

Natural gesture recognition and spatial manipulation

##### Object Manipulation

3D object placement and spatial reasoning

##### Multi-Perspective

Advanced camera systems and viewpoint control

##### Robotic Control

Precise manipulation and automation systems

#### Large-Scale Applications

##### Traffic & Infrastructure

Large-scale traffic simulation and urban planning systems

##### Data Visualisation

Immersive big data analysis and pattern recognition

##### Facility Design

Virtual facility layout and collaborative planning

#### From Octave to the Applied Innovation Lab

The Octave project represents one of the longest-running collaborative VR research programmes in the UK, continuously evolving from 2007 to 2023. That 16-year body of work (multi-user systems, real-world nuclear applications, and AI-mediated teamwork) now forms the research foundation of the DreamLab Applied Innovation Lab.

Research presentation (2015)

### Why the UK Must Lead

Unique convergence of technical, human factors, and research excellence positions the UK to lead in collaborative intelligence.

Addresses critical national challenges: nuclear legacy, complex infrastructure, and safety-critical systems that demand multi-disciplinary collaboration.

Draws on the UK's collaborative culture, world-class AI research, and Responsible Innovation frameworks to set global standards.

The technology is ready, the need is critical, and the payoff could reshape how safety-critical industries plan and train.

### Apply Our Research to Your Challenge

The research heritage of the Octave laboratory is now available through our Applied Innovation Lab. Bring your team to co-create with deep tech.
